subject: Exec workshop — final technical rider & connector spec
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: sanjay@crescentcc.com, marta@avpros.io
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Exec workshop — room spec + AV checklist (May 25-26)

Hi Sanjay / Marta —

Thanks again for the proposal last week. We need to lock the technical rider and confirm connector types for the exec workshop on May 25–26 (Boardroom A, Crescent Tower). High level: 60 people in main room (roundtables + perimeter theater seating), 12 remote execs joining via a single Zoom bridge, and three simultaneous breakouts in adjacent rooms.

Key asks (can you confirm availability/costs by EOD Monday?):
- Room geometry: please confirm exact dimensions of Boardroom A (we need headroom for 3 PTZ cameras + 2 ceiling mics per table). Floorplan reference attached. [Attachment: Crescent_Floorplan_A.pdf]
- Connectivity: dedicated 1 Gbps circuit to the AV rack, public Wi‑Fi is fine for attendees but bridge must use private VLAN.
- Video: 3x 4K PTZ with NDI output and HDMI backup; HDMI run to house switcher.
- Audio: Dante-enabled mixer, 8 lavaliers + 4 boundary mics, redundant audio feed to the breakout rooms.
- Bridge/codec: our preference is a SIP/Zoom Rooms hybrid—SIP registration to our account + Zoom cloud recording. Need exact SIP details you support.
- Recording: local ISO recording per camera and single combined track.
- Show flow: two plenary sessions, one panel (AM), workshop exercises (PM). We will provide cue deck and confidence monitor content.

I'll attach our AV rider (Redwood_AV_Rider_v3.docx) with detailed patch and power requirements. Please flag any conflicts or priced add‑ons. Monica and Markus are looped in for logistics and technical signoff.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Director, Events 
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0142

From: sanjay@crescentcc.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marta@avpros.io, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — room spec + AV checklist (May 25-26)

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the clear list — happy to confirm. Quick answers below, and I attached a high‑res floorplan with our permanent conduit runs annotated. [Attachment: Crescent_Floorplan_A.pdf]

- Boardroom A dimensions: 82' x 48' with 14' ceiling. We have a raised dais option at the front (2' riser) if you want additional camera sightlines.
- Network: we can provision a dedicated 1 Gbps fiber drop into the AV closet and place it on a customer VLAN. Cost: one‑time provisioning fee $450 + $150/day for reserved circuit.
- Video: we have 3 Sony SRG‑XPTZ units available as part of our core rig (NDI/HDMI outputs). HDMI tails run to a Crestron DM switcher in rack 2.
- Audio: house Yamaha Rivage CT is not available but we can provide a DiGiCo SD12 with Dante stageboxes; lavs and boundary mics available at incremental cost (lavs $55/unit/day).
- SIP/Zoom: we support SIP trunking and Zoom Room registration; we will need your SIP URI and preferred dial plan.
- Recording: we can do local multitrack ISO recording to our server; MP4 + WAV masters.

We charged out the extras in the attached quote (see Page 2). Marta — AV lead from AVPros — will confirm mic counts and provide a rack diagram.

Next step: if this looks good Lauren, Monica, can you confirm headcount and breakout room AV requirements (simple projector vs. full AV) by Monday EOD? Once we have that we will lock tech times for load‑in and a follow up walk.

Cheers,
Sanjay Rao
Director, Venue Operations
Crescent Conference Centers
S: 650.555.7922

From: marta@avpros.io
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, sanjay@crescentcc.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — room spec + AV checklist (May 25-26)

Lauren / Sanjay —

Quick technical clarifications from AVPros:

- Camera placement: recommend center aisle ceiling truss + two thirds‑width side mounts (see attached rack_diagram.pdf). For panel closeups use 70–200mm lenses on PTZs.
- Microphone inventory: recommend 8 lavs (CEO, COO, Head of Product, Head of Sales, 4 panelists) + 6 boundary mics for roundtable pickup.
- Redundancy: we will supply a second audio path via analog backup to the house console. Also suggest a cellular failover bridge (Cradlepoint) for Zoom upload in case of WAN outage.
- Latency budgeting: with 1 Gbps private VLAN we can hold bridge latency <120ms round trip.

I can produce a channel list and a one‑page rack diagram by end of day Monday once you confirm final headcount.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Senior Systems Engineer | AVPros
marta@avpros.io | +1 323 555 4410
[Attachment: rack_diagram_stub.pdf]

From: monica.patel@redwood.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: sanjay@crescentcc.com, marta@avpros.io, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — room spec + AV checklist (May 25-26)

Lauren / team —

Confirming headcount and breakout AV:
- Final in‑room headcount (plenary): 62 (two additional staff seats for ops).
- Three breakouts: Room B (30 pax) — projector + single speaker mic; Room C (20 pax) — projector only; Room D (18 pax) — Zoom‑enabled for remote participation, needs laptop + USB speaker/mic.
- Hotel block: Wilson & Co provided a quote for 28 rooms (attached). Please confirm if we should request late checkout for 6 rooms. [Attachment: Hotel_Block_Quote.pdf]

Markus — can you sign off on the lav count and the requirement for ISO camera recording? We prefer ISO per stream for post meeting editing. Vivek — please confirm whether we want the cellular failover provisioned (cost adds ~ $250/day).

Thanks —
Monica
Senior Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 212 555 0198

On Mon, May 18, 2026 at 09:15 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Lauren / team —
> 
> Confirming headcount and breakout AV:
> - Final in‑room headcount (plenary): 62 (two additional staff seats for ops).
> - Three breakouts: Room B (30 pax) — projector + single speaker mic; Room C (20 pax) — projector only; Room D (18 pax) — Zoom‑enabled for remote participation, needs laptop + USB speaker/mic.
> - Hotel block: Wilson & Co provided a quote for 28 rooms (attached). Please confirm if we should request late checkout for 6 rooms. [Attachment: Hotel_Block_Quote.pdf]

Thanks for the details — signed off on:
- Lav count: 8 lavs + 4 boundary mics (match Marta's rec).
- ISO recording: yes — required. Also request independent program mix and a separate stems export for podcast use.
- Cellular failover: yes — provision it. Given that several board members join remotely, redundancy is required.

Lauren — please approve budget add‑ons listed in Sanjay's quote (fiber provisioning + additional lavs + cellular failover). Once greenlit I will send a single PO to Crescent and AVPros so they can schedule load‑in (Tues 5/24 1400–1800).

-Markus
VP, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
